item.title: One MCP directory for all docs.domain.tld (No auth needed)
item.summary: Recently, I have been using MCPs for stripe, cloudflare and many others. While building, a lot of those asked for signing in or auth, even though I wanted to use their docs only. Docs are a great source of truth, especially because they are updated. They are very important to be used with LLMs. The problem with Auth MCPs is fearing to leak something or doing something wrong that could destroy your servers or empty your pocket. Anybody feeling the same? How would you like one directory to rule them all? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49447616 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
